result.query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('vpc',(SELECT to_jsonb(v) FROM network_vpcs v WHERE vpc_id='vpc_1f6fbd7f85cd4baba0b0382770aa480e'),'base',(SELECT to_jsonb(b) FROM network_vpc_base_connectivity b WHERE vpc_id='vpc_1f6fbd7f85cd4baba0b0382770aa480e'),'eip',(SELECT to_jsonb(e) FROM network_eips e WHERE eip_id='eip_19dc90906e7a4461a9a5ad5c050de3ba'),'snat',(SELECT to_jsonb(s) FROM network_snat_bindings s WHERE snat_id='snat_b07400cca95a4ccaa44bac0ced0d7ffb'),'claim',(SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM network_eip_claims c WHERE eip_id='eip_19dc90906e7a4461a9a5ad5c050de3ba'),'operations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',operation_id,'kind',kind,'state',state,'created_at',created_at,'completed_at',completed_at)) FROM network_operations WHERE vpc_id='vpc_1f6fbd7f85cd4baba0b0382770aa480e' OR eip_id='eip_19dc90906e7a4461a9a5ad5c050de3ba' OR snat_id='snat_b07400cca95a4ccaa44bac0ced0d7ffb'));
